platform_info.name: LinkedIn
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in English. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

title.en: Everything LinkedIn has inferred about you
title.nl: Alles wat LinkedIn over jou heeft afgeleid

description.en: The inferred attributes LinkedIn uses to target you with ads, reshaped from Ad_Targeting.csv.
description.nl: De afgeleide kenmerken die LinkedIn gebruikt om je te targeten met advertenties, uit Ad_Targeting.csv.

title.en: Everything LinkedIn has inferred about you
title.nl: Alles wat LinkedIn over jou heeft afgeleid

title.en: Which kind of profile LinkedIn built the most
title.nl: Op welk soort profiel LinkedIn het meest heeft ingezet

documentation.summary: Each row is one inferred attribute value from LinkedIn's ad-targeting profile of the participant, reshaped from a single wide row into one row per value.

columns.Category: The source column this value came from (e.g. Job Titles, Member Interests).
columns.Value: One inferred value LinkedIn has attached to the participant under that category.

title.en: Your contact and registration details on file

description.en: The phone numbers, email addresses, and registration details LinkedIn has on file, from PhoneNumbers.csv, Whatsapp Phone Numbers.csv, Email Addresses.csv and Registration.csv.
description.nl: De telefoonnummers, e-mailadressen en registratiegegevens die LinkedIn heeft geregistreerd, uit PhoneNumbers.csv, Whatsapp Phone Numbers.csv, Email Addresses.csv en Registration.csv.

documentation.summary: One row per contact or registration field LinkedIn has on file, merged from four source files.
documentation.source_file: PhoneNumbers.csv, Whatsapp Phone Numbers.csv, Email Addresses.csv, Registration.csv

columns.Field: Name of the contact or registration field.
columns.Value: Value(s) LinkedIn has on file for that field, joined with '; ' when there is more than one.

description.en: Your first-degree LinkedIn connections, from Connections.csv.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one first-degree LinkedIn connection of the participant.

columns.Email Address: Email address of the connection, if shared.
columns.Position: Current job title of the connection.
columns.Connected On: Date on which the connection was established.

title.nl: Wanneer je met mensen verbonden raakte

description.en: The companies you follow on LinkedIn, from Company Follows.csv.
description.nl: De bedrijven die je op LinkedIn volgt, uit Company Follows.csv.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one company the participant follows on LinkedIn.

columns.Followed On: Date on which the participant started following the company.

title.nl: Wanneer je bedrijven begon te volgen

description.en: Your reactions to posts on LinkedIn, from Reactions.csv.
description.nl: Je reacties op berichten op LinkedIn, uit Reactions.csv.

title.en: The type of reactions you give most
title.nl: Het soort reacties dat je het meest geeft

documentation.summary: Each row represents one reaction the participant gave to a post or content on LinkedIn.

columns.Type: Type of reaction (e.g. Like, Celebrate, Support).

description.en: The comments you posted on LinkedIn content, from Comments.csv.
description.nl: De opmerkingen die je op LinkedIn-content hebt geplaatst, uit Comments.csv.

title.nl: Wanneer je op LinkedIn hebt gereageerd

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant posted on LinkedIn content.

title.nl: Berichten die je hebt gedeeld op LinkedIn

description.en: The posts you shared on LinkedIn, from Shares.csv.
description.nl: De berichten die je op LinkedIn hebt gedeeld, uit Shares.csv.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one post the participant shared on LinkedIn.

columns.SharedUrl: URL of the content that was shared.
columns.MediaUrl: URL of any media attached to the share.
columns.Visibility: Visibility setting of the share (e.g. PUBLIC, CONNECTIONS).

title.nl: Woorden in wat je hebt gedeeld

description.en: Your search queries on LinkedIn, from SearchQueries.csv.
description.nl: Je zoekopdrachten op LinkedIn, uit SearchQueries.csv.

title.en: What you searched for on LinkedIn
title.nl: Waar je naar hebt gezocht op LinkedIn
Je LinkedIn-zoekopdrachten in de loop van de tijd

documentation.summary: Each row represents one search query the participant performed on LinkedIn.

columns.Time: Timestamp of when the search was performed.
columns.Search Query: The search term entered by the participant.

description.en: The ads you clicked on LinkedIn, from Ads Clicked.csv. Note: LinkedIn only provides numeric ad IDs, not ad titles or descriptions.
description.nl: De advertenties waarop je op LinkedIn hebt geklikt, uit Ads Clicked.csv. Let op: LinkedIn geeft alleen numerieke advertentie-ID's, geen titels of beschrijvingen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one advertisement the participant clicked on LinkedIn.

columns.Ad clicked Date: Date on which the ad was clicked.
columns.Ad Title/Id: Title or numeric ID of the clicked advertisement.

description.en: The LinkedIn members you follow, from Member_Follows.csv.
description.nl: De LinkedIn-leden die je volgt, uit Member_Follows.csv.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one LinkedIn member the participant follows.

columns.To: Name or identifier of the followed member.
columns.To Name: Display name of the followed member.
